supersedesOnly: The global candidate-reduction formula in goal3-relation-lifecycle-contract-v1.json endToEndAcceptance.
reason: A source-wide hard budget cannot promise a fixed global compression ratio when most sources generate fewer candidates than the budget. The product invariant is bounded work under pressure without discarding low-volume candidates merely to improve a percentage.
pressureDefinition: A source is under pressure when generated cross candidates exceed the configured source audit budget of 24.

counterfactual.input: All 42 generated candidates from the only pressure source in the frozen v9 candidate ledger.
counterfactual.comparison: Compare the actual v9 selected-candidate audit tokens for that source with the isolated all-42 unbounded replay tokens.

interpretationLimits: Global candidate reduction remains a descriptive metric and is not allowed to penalize low-volume sources.
The counterfactual replay measures audit cost only; it cannot publish or change the v9 canonical snapshot.
A pass establishes bounded Relation-audit work on this frozen pressure case, not unseen-domain recall.
The inverse duplicate canonical RELATED_TO pair is recorded as a separate graph-normalization gap and cannot be hidden by this lifecycle result.
